Graphic Designer Job at DM Holdings (DMH)




        
    

        
        DM Holdings (DMH) is a conglomerate of companies with vast interests in entertainment, hospitality marketing and media business.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Graphic Designer
Job Location: Ojodu Berger, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time 

Job Description


	Are you a creative powerhouse with a passion for transforming ideas into eye-catching visuals? A leading Media & Entertainment Company isseeking a talented Graphics Designer to join our team on a full-time, onsite basis.


Requirements
     

            
    




	A First Degree in any discipline (Fine Arts is an added advantage).
	3 - 4 years of proven experience in creative design & conceptualization.
	Proficiency in graphics design tools/software.
	Strong creativity, attention to detail, and ability to work under pressure.
	Candidates must reside within Ikeja, Ogba, Agege, Ojodu Berger, Akute, or nearby areas.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Graphic Designer - Your Location" as the subject of the mail.

Human Resource Assistant Job at Jules Construction




        
    

        
        Jules Construction is a construction company with key speciality in home and office improvements/Renovation.With qualified and certified engineers in steel works as well as building construction we are determined to make the experience and process of building to be a memorable one. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Human Resource Assistant
Job Location: Shogunle, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time 

Job Summary
     

            
    




	Professional who is responsible for the daily administrative and HR duties of an organization.
	They assist with recruitment and record maintenance for payroll processing as well as provide clerical support to all employees


Responsibilities


	Assist with day to day operations of the HR functions and duties
	Provide clerical and administrative support to Human Resources executives
	Compile and update employee records (hard and soft copies)
	Process documentation and prepare reports relating to personnel activities (staffing, recruitment, training, grievances, performance evaluations etc)
	Coordinate HR projects (meetings, training, surveys etc) and take minutes
	Deal with employee requests regarding human resources issues, rules, and regulations
	Assist in payroll preparation by providing relevant data (absences, bonus, leaves, etc)
	Communicate with public services when necessary
	Properly handle complaints and grievance procedures


Requirements and skills


	Proven experience as an HR Assistant,Staff Assistant or relevant human resources/administrative position
	Fast computer typing skills (MS Office, in particular)
	Hands-on experience with an HRIS or HRMS
	Familiarity with ATS software and resume databases
	Basic knowledge of labor laws
	Excellent organizational skills
	Strong communications skills


Salary
N100,000 - N120,000 per month. 

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Medical Officer",
  "description": "Medbury Healthcare is an integrated healthcare organization with interests and investments that span across the healthcare value chain. We are building an ecosystem that delivers superior healthcare solutions to Africa. We are fixing Healthcare in Africa; you should join us.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Medical Officer&nbsp;

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	We are seeking a passionate, patient-focused, and forward-thinking Medical Officer to join our Wellness &amp; Longevity team.
	This role is ideal for a medical professional with a keen interest in preventive healthcare, aesthetic medicine, wellness, and longevity, who is eager to grow in an innovative and rapidly evolving field.
	While prior experience in aesthetics or wellness medicine is an advantage, we welcome candidates with a genuine desire to learn and build a career in this specialty.
	Successful candidates will receive structured training in our clinical protocols and evidence-based approaches to wellness and longevity medicine.


Key Responsibilities


	Conduct comprehensive patient consultations and clinical assessments.
	Develop and implement individualized treatment and wellness plans.
	Support the delivery of aesthetic, preventive, and longevity-focused healthcare services.
	Educate patients on lifestyle modification, disease prevention, and healthy living.
	Maintain accurate clinical documentation and ensure compliance with regulatory and clinical standards.
	Collaborate effectively with a multidisciplinary team to deliver exceptional patient care.
	Participate in continuous learning and training in wellness, longevity, and aesthetic medicine.


Requirements


	MBBS or equivalent medical Degree from a recognized institution.
	Minimum of 2 years of post-qualification clinical experience.
	Current practicing license with the Medical and Dental Council of Nigeria (MDCN).
	Previous experience in aesthetic medicine, wellness, lifestyle medicine, or preventive healthcare is an added advantage.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Strong clinical judgement, attention to detail, and a high level of professionalism.
	Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a multidisciplinary team.

Medical Officer Job at Medbury Medical Services




        
    

        
        Medbury Healthcare is an integrated healthcare organization with interests and investments that span across the healthcare value chain. We are building an ecosystem that delivers superior healthcare solutions to Africa. We are fixing Healthcare in Africa; you should join us.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Medical Officer 

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role
     

            
    




	We are seeking a passionate, patient-focused, and forward-thinking Medical Officer to join our Wellness & Longevity team.
	This role is ideal for a medical professional with a keen interest in preventive healthcare, aesthetic medicine, wellness, and longevity, who is eager to grow in an innovative and rapidly evolving field.
	While prior experience in aesthetics or wellness medicine is an advantage, we welcome candidates with a genuine desire to learn and build a career in this specialty.
	Successful candidates will receive structured training in our clinical protocols and evidence-based approaches to wellness and longevity medicine.


Key Responsibilities


	Conduct comprehensive patient consultations and clinical assessments.
	Develop and implement individualized treatment and wellness plans.
	Support the delivery of aesthetic, preventive, and longevity-focused healthcare services.
	Educate patients on lifestyle modification, disease prevention, and healthy living.
	Maintain accurate clinical documentation and ensure compliance with regulatory and clinical standards.
	Collaborate effectively with a multidisciplinary team to deliver exceptional patient care.
	Participate in continuous learning and training in wellness, longevity, and aesthetic medicine.


Requirements


	MBBS or equivalent medical Degree from a recognized institution.
	Minimum of 2 years of post-qualification clinical experience.
	Current practicing license with the Medical and Dental Council of Nigeria (MDCN).
	Previous experience in aesthetic medicine, wellness, lifestyle medicine, or preventive healthcare is an added advantage.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Strong clinical judgement, attention to detail, and a high level of professionalism.
	Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a multidisciplinary team.
	A proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and commitment to continuous professional development.


What We're Looking For
The ideal candidate is someone who:


	Has a genuine passion for wellness, preventive medicine, and longevity.
	Understands the importance of promoting healthy living by modelling a healthy lifestyle.
	Demonstrates empathy, professionalism, and exceptional patient care.
	Is adaptable, eager to learn, and open to specialized training.
	Is interested in building a long-term career within the wellness and longevity space.


Why Join Us?


	Opportunity to build a career in the rapidly growing field of wellness and longevity medicine.
	Structured training and mentorship in specialized clinical protocols.
	Collaborative and innovative work environment.
	Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.

Our mission is to foster sustainable financial growth for individuals and institutions by delivering trusted advice and tailored financial solutions. We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Licensed Stockbroker / Treasury Officer 

Job Location: Central Business District, Abuja (FCT)

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking an agile Stockbroker / Treasury Officer. This is an active trading role for a market speculator, not a passive investor.


Key Responsibilities


	Daily Market Trading: Execute real-time proprietary and portfolio trades in equities and fixed-income instruments to capture short-term margin spreads.
	Terminal & Liquidity Management: Manage the firm's remote trading terminal to ensure rapid daily market interventions, locking in gains and offloading positions swiftly before corrections.
	?Portfolio & Fund Rebalancing: Actively monitor and manage mutual funds and portfolios to maximize short-term returns in line with the firm’s speculative mandate.
	?Treasury & Capital Market Operations: Handle daily liquidity positioning, cash flow management, and institutional relationships with brokerages, custodians, and regulators.
	Financial & Trading Reporting: Prepare daily trading logs, weekly portfolio valuation reports, and comprehensive managerial financial statements.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics
	?CIS professional qualification is a strong advantage.
	?Proven experience in active trading and treasury within a reputable financial institution.
	?Strong analytical, reporting, and real-time market risk assessment skills.
	?High level of integrity and attention to detail.


Salary
